citations.claim: first energy_bound violation: energy well above E0+10%+5J
energy just below limit one step before, showing sudden injection at bounce

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.03333 to 0.0001 keeping all else identical; fine integration conserves energy so violation disappears

explanation: Two elastic (e=1) vertically stacked circles fall under g=30 with coarse dt=1/30. Light lower body bounces on floor then collides head-on with heavy falling upper body. Impulse plus positional correction at large penetration / high relative speed injects net kinetic energy (slingshot), raising total mechanical energy from 363J to 498.6J with zero controller work, exceeding 404.3J limit. Small-dt rerun conserves energy, implicating coarse-step collision resolution.
vision_note: Two vertically stacked circles drift downward together and the gap between them closes to near-contact by step 55. No floor, bounce, or sudden energetic separation is visible in these frames. [disagreement: Explanation claims a floor bounce followed by a head-on collision with energy slingshot, but no floor or upward motion is seen, no ejection is visible, and neither body is shown red as the violating body.]
